title: Low Sodium Layered Ukrainian Vine Leaves Stew
description: A dense and savory Ukrainian dish featuring vine leaves and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a kazan cauldron with low sodium ingredients. This stew is a hearty and comforting meal option.
instructions: Heat the kazan cauldron over medium heat and add the ground pork to cook until browned.
Add the onions, garlic, carrots, and potatoes to the cauldron and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef broth, black pepper, and paprika to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Add the vine leaves to the cauldron, layering them on top of the vegetable mixture.
Add the ferment-kimchi to the cauldron, spooning it over the vine leaves.
Cover the cauldron and simmer the stew for 30 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional vine leaves if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
